##### 操作步骤
1.服务器管理软件点击“邮件配置”；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=79bf91d81fd122e8649e1e283b535014)
2.配置发送邮件的邮箱，密码即为授权码；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=bbe32893f50e45b83adba77badc4aa1e)
3.获取授权码，以下QQ邮箱为例；
a.登录邮箱-设置-帐户；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=317589dd7561a90e7d42d962295d6a78)
b.帐户页面下拉，IMAP/SMTP服务开启后才会生成授权码；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=13846cfade5b0ef5adc2eb5ea7234550)
c.发短信内容为：配置邮件客户端 到1069070069,在发送成功了之后点击我已发送;
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=34581596c3100782b3b245f60a054ee9)
d.点我已发送后就会出来对应的授权码（密码）；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d14fdc71a94529f28bf593b279777ee5)
e.获取SMTP地址，端口，安全链接；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d2af68dc1db9448f365b59fb445698c6)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=7e32d2147d73b8089ce4d89d735bf42c)
4.配置授权码和相应SMTP信息；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=ead7244757d5122575974f47bd8af6da)
5.测试发送邮件；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=12e00a7617bb7978bfa1ff17648384be)
注：邮件配置只有先进行测试，测试成功了之后才能在平台上进行实际的运用；
6.配置好了之后，就可以在规则管理里面添加规则,配置接收邮件的地址了（可以同时配置多个，用;分隔）；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0e653e964a8cd131cefb34063b0647a2)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=12141fd9d36fcc898cae0beda1354d47)
7.配置规则还要进行分配，只有分配了规则的设备才会执行这个规则，设备在对应的报警触发了之后，就会有发邮件的功能；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=54167ef976a9e6d13e0893d0f3828864)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0b4978ac9f3997f2310a2426e6272141)
8.分配好了之后，最好再单独重启一下网关服务器；
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f4a31728b2a0bed20aef29fad8967a6a)
